import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv')

# Extract the relevant citation metrics for original and replication studies
original_avg_citations = df['author_citations_avg.o'].dropna()
replication_avg_citations = df['author_citations_avg.r'].dropna()

original_max_citations = df['author_citations_max.o'].dropna()
replication_max_citations = df['author_citations_max.r'].dropna()

# Perform t-tests for average citations
t_test_avg = stats.ttest_ind(original_avg_citations, replication_avg_citations)

# Perform t-tests for max citations
t_test_max = stats.ttest_ind(original_max_citations, replication_max_citations)

t_test_avg, t_test_max
